messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV1 alert triggered for embeddings->rerank pipeline (us-east). Error spike past threshold. Auto-created incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-1775012345

Ravi Singh: Taking pager. Brief symptom seen in logs: reranker process terminated with VectorLengthMismatch on batched input. Seen across 3 replicas.

Ellie Park: Can someone paste a representative error and the batch manifest? Need to see if it's a single bad item or the batch aggregator mixing dims.

Luis Ortega: Paste below. Note: we saw this right after a scheduled config rollout for embedder feature flags.

ERROR: panic: VectorLengthMismatch: expected=768 got=512
  at reranker/serve.go:210 processBatch
  request: {batch_id: "batch-22d", items: [{id: "p1", dim:768}, {id: "p2", dim:512}, {id: "p3", dim:768}]}

Support Bot: Noted 27 affected requests in last 2 minutes, 14 unique customer IDs (highest impact: acct-903, acct-112). Notifying support team channels.

Ravi Singh: Hypothesis 1: embedder upstream returned mixed-dimension vectors inside a single batch (maybe routing to two model variants). Hypothesis 2: batcher merging results from two different sessions (race). Hypothesis 3: a partial quantized fallback returned 512-dim unexpectedly.

Ellie Park: Evidence #1: batcher trace shows two upstream responses with model tags: embed-v3 (dim=768) and embed-v3-quant (dim=512). Log snippet: 
```
INFO batcher: upstream responses: [{item:p1, model:embed-v3, len:768},{item:p2, model:embed-v3-quant, len:512}]
```
Ellie Park: Evidence #2: no reranker code path found that validates input dims before tensor ops. Current loop: 
```
for _, vec := range vectors {
  out := computeScores(vec, ctxQuery) // assumes vec.len == cfg.Dim
}
```
Luis Ortega: Timeline rough draft:
- 1775012100: embedder feature-flag rollout started (canary)
- 1775012185: routing rule flip for quantized variant (auto)
- 1775012258: first panic observed on reranker pod A
- 1775012345: incident auto-detected and paged oncall

Ravi Singh: Immediate mitigations we should try now:
1) Stop routing to quantized variant (rollback routing change).
2) Patch batcher to validate homogenous "vector_len" per batch and reject mixed batches.
3) Add protective check in reranker to skip mismatched items and surface metric.
Which of these can we do fastest?

Ellie Park: I can push a small reranker guard in ~15min that will skip and log mismatches to avoid panics. Luis, can you pin routing back to non-quant?

Luis Ortega: Pinning routing: applying rc lock to force embed-v3 for all production keys in us-east. Change id rc-1775012403. Will monitor.

Ellie Park: Pushed PR #4872: reranker dim-guard. Behavior: drop mismatched vector, emit metric rerank.input_dim_mismatch and return 206 with per-item detail for batches. Rolling to canary now.

Ravi Singh: Batcher-side quick fix: I'll add an ingress check to validate that all items share same vector_len before forwarding. If mismatch, return 422 and tag batch as mismatch. Estimate 12m for hotfix.

Support Bot: Support notified customers: acct-903 and acct-112 flagged for immediate outreach. Ops page created for status page.

Luis Ortega: After pinning routing, traffic to quantized variant dropped to zero. Early metrics: reranker panics ceased on canary nodes.

Ellie Park: Canary with reranker guard shows no crashes; mismatched items are now logged and metrics emitted. Promoting to prod in 8m.

Ravi Singh: Deployed batcher ingress validation to prod (1775012610). New behavior: if batch contains >1 distinct "vector_len", reject and return JSON with offending item IDs. Metric: batcher.mismatched_batch_count incremented.

Luis Ortega: With routing pinned + batcher guard + reranker guard, error rate dropped from ~48% to ~0.8% within ~4 minutes. A small number of 422 responses correspond to queued mixed batches. Customer impact mostly resolved; support is following up with the two highest-impacted accounts.

Ellie Park: Root-cause candidates: non-deterministic routing during canary (rcorunner auto-flip) caused some requests to hit quantized embedder; batcher assumed single-model semantics and merged responses blindly; reranker lacked input validation and panicked on size mismatch.

Ravi Singh: Action items (owners):
- Luis: Harden router config to never mix model variants within a single batch key; add e2e to assert stable routing during rollout.
- Ellie: Add strict input validation and unit tests in reranker, plus a postmortem PR expanding coverage.
- Ravi: Make batcher enforce homogenous model per batch and add test simulating mixed upstream dims.
- Support: Notify customers in the incident doc and schedule follow-up calls for acct-903, acct-112.

Luis Ortega: Added follow-up: add a canary gating check to prevent automated reroutes during rapid traffic shifts.

Support Bot: Incident status -> mitigated; monitoring. Next update required in 3 hours or on regression.

Ravi Singh: Handoff note for next oncall:
- What happened: mixed-dimension vectors from embedder variants got merged into a single batch; reranker panicked.
- What we did: pinned routing away from quantized variant, added batcher ingress validation, added reranker defensive guard.
- Remaining work: router rollout hardening, permanent batcher segmentation of model variants, add e2e tests + runbook update.

Ellie Park: I'll start drafting the formal RCA doc with timeline, log extracts, and links to the PRs: PR#4872 (reranker guard), PR#4880 (batcher guard), router RC rc-1775012403.

Luis Ortega: Leaving note in deploy log: rollback not required; mitigations preferred. Will follow up with infra to ensure canary gating change.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1775012345 state updated: resolved -> monitoring. Record will be archived after postmortem complete.
